# Integration note: docs/design/stage2/mech_east.md.
# Scripted effects take no parameters in 1.19.3 (decision E1): a call sets zin_arg_<name> temporary variables first.
# road: salt 1, gold 2, rift 3, lake 4, sand 5.

zin_east_add_road_influence = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_salt min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_gold min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 3 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_rift min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 4 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_lake min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 5 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_sand min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

zin_east_add_all_roads = {
	add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_salt min = 0 max = 100 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_gold min = 0 max = 100 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_rift min = 0 max = 100 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_lake min = 0 max = 100 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_sand min = 0 max = 100 }
}

zin_east_add_rivalry = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_east_rivalry min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord_cap
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry > 30 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry = 30 }
	}
}

zin_east_add_lean = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_east_lean }
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_lean = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_lean min = -100 max = 100 }
	}
}

zin_east_refresh_wealth = {
	set_variable = { zin_east_charters = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = NRS }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_lake = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = STA }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_lake = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_charters = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord }
		set_variable = { zin_east_charters = 2.5 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_cw_pp = zin_east_charters }
	multiply_variable = { zin_east_cw_pp = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { zin_east_cw_trade = zin_east_charters }
	multiply_variable = { zin_east_cw_trade = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { zin_east_cw_cg = zin_east_charters }
	multiply_variable = { zin_east_cw_cg = -0.01 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

zin_east_update_dominance = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_east_mine = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_east_allies = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_east_lands = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = { is_subject_of = PREV.PREV }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_mine = 1 }
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_east_lands = yes
			NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV }
			controller = {
				is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
				NOT = { is_subject_of = PREV.PREV }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_allies = 1 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_east_allies = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_mine = zin_east_allies }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_east_mine = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_east_mine = global.zin_east_states_total }
	set_variable = { zin_east_dominance = zin_east_mine }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_dominance min = 0 max = 100 }
}

zin_east_count_roads = {
	set_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_salt = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_road_salt = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = PREV.PREV
						is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_ctrl_salt = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_gold = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_road_gold = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = PREV.PREV
						is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_ctrl_gold = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_rift = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_road_rift = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = PREV.PREV
						is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_ctrl_rift = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_lake = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_road_lake = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = PREV.PREV
						is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_ctrl_lake = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_sand = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_road_sand = yes
			OR = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				controller = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = PREV.PREV
						is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_ctrl_sand = 1 }
	}
}

zin_east_charter_changed = {
	# the loser is shaken, the winner is envied; the news goes to both powers and to every court on the road
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = 1 } }
		STA = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_east_in_crisis days = 365 }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = NRS modifier = zin_east_charter_lost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = 2 } }
		NRS = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_east_in_crisis days = 365 }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = STA modifier = zin_east_charter_lost }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { country_event = { id = zin_east.10 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { country_event = { id = zin_east.10 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_salt = yes }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_gold = yes }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 3 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_rift = yes }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 4 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_lake = yes }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 5 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_sand = yes }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.10 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_roads_month = {
	# a power that is gone leaves the survivor +20 influence on each road, once
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = NRS }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_noris_gone }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_noris_gone
		STA = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 20 }
			zin_east_add_all_roads = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = STA }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_stabilo_gone }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_stabilo_gone
		NRS = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 20 }
			zin_east_add_all_roads = yes
		}
	}
	NRS = { zin_east_count_roads = yes }
	STA = { zin_east_count_roads = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_moved = 0 }
	# salt
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_salt = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_salt = zin_east_ctrl_salt } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_salt = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_salt = zin_east_ctrl_salt } }
	}
	NRS = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_sc_salt }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_salt > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_salt min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	STA = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_nc_salt }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_salt > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_salt min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	# a power that is gone gives up the charters it held
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = NRS }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = STA }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 0 }
	}
	# charters freeze while the Concord holds
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord } }
		# conquest: two thirds of the road in one alliance's hands
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = global.zin_east_roadn_salt }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = 2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = -0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n3 = zin_e_nc_salt }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_n3 = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s3 = zin_e_sc_salt }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_s3 = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_salt > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_n3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 100 } }
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_salt > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 100 } }
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 0 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NRS }
			NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = zin_east_inf_salt } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = STA }
			STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = zin_east_inf_salt } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_n }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_s }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_s }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_n }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_salt }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = NRS
					check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_lead > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = STA
					check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_back > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 }
				country_exists = STA
				check_variable = { zin_e_n < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 2 }
				country_exists = NRS
				check_variable = { zin_e_s < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
		}
		# one charter changes hands in a month, so the news names the right road; another waits for the next month
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_e_moved = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_salt } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_moved = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = zin_e_new }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = zin_e_new }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
			zin_east_charter_changed = yes
		}
	}
	# courts on a held road drift toward its holder
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_salt = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_salt = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	# gold
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_gold = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_gold = zin_east_ctrl_gold } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_gold = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_gold = zin_east_ctrl_gold } }
	}
	NRS = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_sc_gold }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_gold > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_gold min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	STA = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_nc_gold }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_gold > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_gold min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	# a power that is gone gives up the charters it held
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = NRS }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = STA }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 0 }
	}
	# charters freeze while the Concord holds
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord } }
		# conquest: two thirds of the road in one alliance's hands
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = global.zin_east_roadn_gold }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = 2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = -0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n3 = zin_e_nc_gold }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_n3 = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s3 = zin_e_sc_gold }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_s3 = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_gold > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_n3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 100 } }
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_gold > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 100 } }
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 0 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NRS }
			NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = zin_east_inf_gold } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = STA }
			STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = zin_east_inf_gold } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_n }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_s }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_s }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_n }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_gold }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = NRS
					check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_lead > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = STA
					check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_back > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 1 }
				country_exists = STA
				check_variable = { zin_e_n < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 }
				country_exists = NRS
				check_variable = { zin_e_s < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
		}
		# one charter changes hands in a month, so the news names the right road; another waits for the next month
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_e_moved = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_gold } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_moved = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = zin_e_new }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 2 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = zin_e_new }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
			zin_east_charter_changed = yes
		}
	}
	# courts on a held road drift toward its holder
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_gold = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_gold = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	# rift
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_rift = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_nc_rift = zin_east_ctrl_rift } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_rift = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_sc_rift = zin_east_ctrl_rift } }
	}
	NRS = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_sc_rift }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_rift > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_rift min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	STA = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_other = zin_e_nc_rift }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_ctrl_rift > zin_e_other } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 0.3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = zin_east_caravan_bonus }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 80 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = -0.2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_inf_rift min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	# a power that is gone gives up the charters it held
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = NRS }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { country_exists = STA }
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 0 }
	}
	# charters freeze while the Concord holds
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord } }
		# conquest: two thirds of the road in one alliance's hands
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = global.zin_east_roadn_rift }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_total3 = 2 }

				check_variable = { zin_e_n3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 100 } }
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_sand > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s3 > zin_e_total3 }
			}
			STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 100 } }
			NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 0 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = NRS }
			NRS = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_n = zin_east_inf_sand } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = STA }
			STA = { set_temp_variable = { zin_e_s = zin_east_inf_sand } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_n }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_lead = zin_e_s }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_s }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_back = zin_e_n }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_sand }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = NRS
					check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_lead > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = STA
					check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
					check_variable = { zin_e_back > 19.99 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 1 }
				country_exists = STA
				check_variable = { zin_e_n < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_s > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 2 }
				country_exists = NRS
				check_variable = { zin_e_s < 40 }
				check_variable = { zin_e_n > 59.99 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_new = 1 }
		}
		# one charter changes hands in a month, so the news names the right road; another waits for the next month
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_e_moved = 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { zin_e_new = global.zin_east_road_sand } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_e_moved = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = zin_e_new }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 5 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = zin_e_new }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
			zin_east_charter_changed = yes
		}
	}
	# courts on a held road drift toward its holder
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_sand = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_road_sand = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.1 }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	NRS = { zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes }
	STA = { zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes }
}

zin_east_update_bias = {
	# the eastern pressures toward kneeling (spec section 4); recomputed every month
	set_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_owes_temples }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_in_crisis }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			any_other_country = {
				is_faction_leader = yes
				is_in_faction_with = PREV
				has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt > 29.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { STA = { has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_rival_banks } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -20 }
		}
		else = { add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -10 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_pledged }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_east_route_resist
				has_country_flag = zin_noris_route_shield
				has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_route_free
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_noris_route_high_king
				has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_route_empire
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				zin_east_rule_refuse = yes
				zin_east_rule_unite = yes
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -100 }
	}
	# a client that delayed the King's host (zin_east.52) leans away for a year
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_delayed_host }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_east_b = -20 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = zin_east_b }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_east_kneel_bias min = -100 max = 100 }
}

zin_east_compute_weight = {
	# the coalition weight of one East Lands country (spec section 5); kept as a country variable for the AI of zin_east.42
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = zin_footholds }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 10 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_states = num_owned_states }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_e_states = 2 }
	# rounded down: a half becomes a quarter below, and rounds to the whole below
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_states = -0.25 }
	round_temp_variable = zin_e_states
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_e_states min = 0 max = 15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = zin_e_states }
	if = {
		limit = { zin_east_faces_rift = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_ambition }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_in_crisis }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_whispered }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = 10 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_bias5 = zin_east_kneel_bias }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_e_bias5 = 5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = zin_e_bias5 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = -30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = -20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_route_resist }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = -50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_noris_route_shield
				has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_route_free
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_w = -100 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = zin_e_w }
}

zin_east_join_coalition = {
	# the join option of zin_east.42
	set_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
	add_ideas = zin_east_coalition_ambition
}

zin_east_pick_leader = {
	# the leader: the highest weight among East Lands countries with 8 or more states (ties: most states, then tag)
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion }
			NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader } }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				check_variable = { num_owned_states > 7.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_declined_lead }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_east_in_region = yes
						check_variable = { num_owned_states > 7.99 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_declined_lead }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight > PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				zin_east_join_coalition = yes
			}
			else = { country_event = { id = zin_east.42 } }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_stay_out = {
	# the stay-out option of zin_east.42: a leader that declines passes the lead to the next court
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		clr_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader
		clr_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
		set_country_flag = zin_east_declined_lead
		remove_ideas = zin_east_coalition_ambition
		zin_east_pick_leader = yes
	}
}

zin_east_form_coalition = {
	# the coalition gathers (called by the hidden zin_east.41 on the runner): weights, the leader, the asks, the crossing in 30 days
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_coalition_formed } }
		set_global_flag = zin_east_coalition_formed
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
			zin_east_compute_weight = yes
		}
		zin_east_pick_leader = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
				check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight > 49.99 }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.42 }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_east.3 days = 30 }
	}
}

zin_east_enforce_coalition = {
	# historical path: at least 2 AI members besides the leader (the highest weights join)
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_joined = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_joined = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_e_joined < 1.99 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_east_in_region = yes
						is_ai = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight > PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			zin_east_join_coalition = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_joined = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_e_joined < 1.99 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_east_in_region = yes
						is_ai = yes
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight > PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
							}
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight = PREV.zin_east_coalition_weight }
								check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			zin_east_join_coalition = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_joined = 1 }
	}
}

zin_east_cross_rift = {
	# the crossing of the rift (spec section 5 step 4; the hidden zin_east.3, 30 days after the coalition gathers)
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion }
			any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
			zin_east_enforce_coalition = yes
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
			save_event_target_as = zin_east_leader
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
		set_global_flag = { flag = zin_east_invasion_young days = 120 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
			set_variable = { zin_east_rift_count = 0 }
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
				add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_east_rift_count = 1 }
			}
		}
		# up to 3 realms that own rift-coast states, those with the most first (ties: tag); the war takes the claimed coast
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
						check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count = PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target
			save_event_target_as = zin_east_rift_foe
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
				add_claim_by = event_target:zin_east_leader
			}
			event_target:zin_east_leader = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe } }
					declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe type = take_claimed_state }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
					NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe }
				}
				add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = event_target:zin_east_leader enemy = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe hostility_reason = asked_to_join single_target_only = yes }
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
						check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count = PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target
			save_event_target_as = zin_east_rift_foe
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
				add_claim_by = event_target:zin_east_leader
			}
			event_target:zin_east_leader = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe } }
					declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe type = take_claimed_state }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
					NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe }
				}
				add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = event_target:zin_east_leader enemy = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe hostility_reason = asked_to_join single_target_only = yes }
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
						check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > 0.99 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count > PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_rift_count = PREV.zin_east_rift_count }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_rift_target
			save_event_target_as = zin_east_rift_foe
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
				add_claim_by = event_target:zin_east_leader
			}
			event_target:zin_east_leader = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe } }
					declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe type = take_claimed_state }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
					NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe }
				}
				add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = event_target:zin_east_leader enemy = event_target:zin_east_rift_foe hostility_reason = asked_to_join single_target_only = yes }
			}
		}
		# members with three footholds or more gain the eastern ambition against the realms and Aenor
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
				check_variable = { zin_footholds > 2.99 }
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
				PREV = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_eastern_ambition scope = PREV days = 730 } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_eastern_ambition scope = AEN days = 730 }
		}
		zin_elves_on_eastern_invasion = yes
		news_event = { id = zin_east.43 }
	}
}

zin_east_turn_west = {
	# the host turns west (spec section 5 step 5): the leader declares on Aenor, whoever rules it, and the members join
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_turns_west }
			any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_turns_west
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = AEN }
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = AEN } }
					declare_war_on = { target = AEN type = annex_everything }
				}
				save_event_target_as = zin_east_leader
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
					NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
				}
				add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = event_target:zin_east_leader enemy = AEN hostility_reason = asked_to_join single_target_only = yes }
			}
		}
		news_event = { id = zin_east.44 }
	}
}

zin_east_make_coalition_peace = {
	# the make-peace option of zin_east.45: white peace with every enemy in the Magical and Middle Lands
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = PREV
			zin_east_has_capital = yes
			capital_scope = {
				OR = {
					zin_is_region_magical_lands = yes
					zin_is_region_middle_lands = yes
				}
			}
		}
		PREV = { white_peace = PREV }
	}
	remove_ideas = zin_east_coalition_ambition
	set_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_peace
}

zin_east_offer_coalition_peace = {
	# zin_east.45 to every coalition member at once, whatever the King of the East (the trees' Break the Coalition)
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
		set_country_flag = zin_east_peace_asked
		country_event = { id = zin_east.45 }
	}
}

zin_east_claim_rift = {
	# claims on every rift-coast state of the Magical Lands that the coalition holds (the trees' spoils focuses)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
			has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_site_rift_west = yes
				controller = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
			}
			add_claim_by = PREV
		}
	}
}

	army_experience = 10

zin_east_order_home = {

}

zin_east_claim_road = {
	# claims on the road states the rival and its faction own (zin_arg_road: salt 1, gold 2, rift 3, lake 4, sand 5); only with a peace gate open
	if = {
		limit = { zin_east_claims_open = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_road = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = NRS }
				every_state = {
					limit = {
						zin_is_site_road_salt = yes
						owner = {
							OR = {
								original_tag = STA
								is_in_faction_with = STA
							}
						}
					}
					add_claim_by = PREV
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = STA }
				every_state = {
					limit = {
						zin_is_site_road_salt = yes
						owner = {
							OR = {
								original_tag = NRS
								is_in_faction_with = NRS
							}
						}
					}
					add_claim_by = PREV
				}
			}
		}

						zin_is_site_road_lake = yes

zin_east_grant_free_cb = {
	# the cause against the Dominion of the East and every client, while the King of the East reigns
	if = {
		limit = { zin_east_free_crown = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = WOR
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = WOR } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = WOR days = 1825 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = PREV } } }
					add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = PREV days = 1825 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_east_grant_high_king_cb = {
	# the unification route's cause (spec section 7): courts leaning to the rival and courts that knelt
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
				has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_is_court = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client
					AND = {
						PREV = { original_tag = NRS }
						check_variable = { zin_east_lean < 0 }
					}
					AND = {
						PREV = { original_tag = STA }
						check_variable = { zin_east_lean > 0 }
					}
				}
			}
			PREV = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_high_king scope = PREV days = 730 } }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_declare_united = {
	# the East united (spec section 7); an outcome of the game, never history. World systems read zin_east_united.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_east_dominance > 49.99 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_united }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_united
		add_ideas = zin_east_united_crown
		news_event = { id = zin_east.80 }
	}
}

zin_east_prepare_kneel = {
	# before kneeling (called by the kneel of zin_afrit.51): the ruling ideology and the elections are kept to restore them when the King falls
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		set_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		set_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = communism }
		set_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_elections = yes }
		set_country_flag = zin_east_had_elections
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		every_other_country = {
			limit = {
				is_faction_leader = yes
				is_in_faction_with = PREV
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_knelt }
		}
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	# a subject of another country stays that country's subject; it only opens its roads to the Dominion
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject = yes }
		give_military_access = WOR
	}
}

zin_east_restore_ideology = {
	# the government returns to the ideology it had before kneeling, with the elections it had
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zin_east_old_ideology }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 0 }
				NOT = { has_government = democratic }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_had_elections }
				set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
			}
			else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 1 }
				NOT = { has_government = fascism }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_had_elections }
				set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes }
			}
			else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 2 }
				NOT = { has_government = communism }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_had_elections }
				set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes }
			}
			else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_east_old_ideology = 3 }
				NOT = { has_government = neutrality }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_had_elections }
				set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes }
			}
			else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_refuse_king = {
	# the refuse option of zin_east.50 (and of zin_afrit.51)
	set_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
}

zin_east_gifts_to_king = {
	# the gifts option of zin_east.50: no subject relation, only the King's goodwill
	WOR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_gifts_to_king } }
}

zin_east_enforce_refusers = {
	# historical path: at least 2 East Lands countries refuse (the AI courts with the lowest bias first; ties: most states, then tag)
	if = {
		limit = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_refusers = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_refusers = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_e_refusers < 1.99 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_east_is_court = yes
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
					NOT = {
						any_other_country = {
							zin_east_is_court = yes
							is_ai = yes
							NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
							NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
							OR = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias < PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
								AND = {
									check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
									check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
									check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
									check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				zin_east_refuse_king = yes
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_refusers = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_e_refusers < 1.99 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_east_is_court = yes
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
					NOT = {
						any_other_country = {
							zin_east_is_court = yes
							is_ai = yes
							NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
							NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
							OR = {
								check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias < PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
								AND = {
									check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
									check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
								}
								AND = {
									check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = PREV.zin_east_kneel_bias }
									check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
									check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				zin_east_refuse_king = yes
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_refusers = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_name_first_crown = {
	# the First of the Free Crowns, when no tree's resist focus has named one: the refuser with most states that leads a faction, else the refuser with most states
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_free_crowns_leader } } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					zin_east_free_crown = yes
					is_faction_leader = yes
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_east_free_crown = yes
					is_faction_leader = yes
					NOT = {
						any_other_country = {
							zin_east_free_crown = yes
							is_faction_leader = yes
							OR = {
								check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
								AND = {
									check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
									check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_east_free_crowns_leader
				country_event = { id = zin_east.51 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_east_free_crown = yes
					NOT = {
						any_other_country = {
							zin_east_free_crown = yes
							OR = {
								check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
								AND = {
									check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
									check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = zin_east_free_crowns_leader
				country_event = { id = zin_east.51 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_east_king_notice = {
	# zin_east.50 to every East Lands court that the Deliverer did not ask (the hidden zin_east.5, 30 days after the proclamation)
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_east_is_court = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
			NOT = { zin_afrit_eastern_candidate = yes }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_east.50 }
	}
}

zin_east_delay_host = {
	# the delay option of zin_east.52: the bias falls for a year, and the Dominion remembers
	set_country_flag = { flag = zin_east_delayed_host days = 365 }
	WOR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_host_delayed } }
}

zin_east_after_the_king = {
	# the East after the King (spec section 6), once: clients released and indebted, refusers vindicated, the Free Crowns' cause ends, the old quarrels return
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_after_king_done } }
		set_global_flag = zin_east_after_king_done
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = WOR }
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
				PREV = { remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_free_east scope = PREV } }
			}
			remove_ideas = zin_east_free_crowns
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_east_vindicated days = 730 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject_of = WOR }
				WOR = { end_puppet = PREV }
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_east_kings_debt days = 730 }
			zin_east_restore_ideology = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry < 50 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry = 50 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_east.60 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_dig_wells_in = {
	# wells in this state: the flag, wells instead of dry land, and a road
	set_state_flag = zin_east_wells
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = zin_east_dry_land }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_east_dry_land }
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_east_wells }
	add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
}

zin_east_wells_random = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_south_lands = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = zin_east_wells }
		}
		zin_east_dig_wells_in = yes
	}
}

zin_east_rivalry_month = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 0 }
			NRS = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 39.99 } }
			STA = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 39.99 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 0 }
			NRS = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 39.99 } }
			STA = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 39.99 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 0 }
			NRS = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 39.99 } }
			STA = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 39.99 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_lake = 0 }
			NRS = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake > 39.99 } }
			STA = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake > 39.99 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 0 }
			NRS = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand > 39.99 } }
			STA = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand > 39.99 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			NRS = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
			STA = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NRS = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
					STA = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
				}
				AND = {
					STA = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
					NRS = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	# drift toward 40
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry > 40.19 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.2 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry < 39.81 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.2 }
		zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
	}
}

zin_east_country_month = {
	zin_east_update_bias = yes
	# a South Lands court owns at least half its states in the desert
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_south = 0 }
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_region_south_lands = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_south = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_e_diff = zin_e_south }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_e_diff = 2 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_e_diff = num_owned_states }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_e_south > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { zin_e_diff > -0.01 }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_east_south_court
	}
	else = { clr_country_flag = zin_east_south_court }
	if = {
		limit = { has_stability < 0.3 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_east_in_crisis days = 365 }
	}
}

zin_east_free_crowns_month = {
	# the Free Crowns while the King of the East reigns: the spirit, the cause, kinship among refusers, scorn for clients
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		}
		# new clients first, so that a refuser and a client of the same month are counted once
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_client_set }
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_client_set
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_free_crown_set }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_knelt }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_east_free_crown = yes }
			zin_east_grant_free_cb = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_free_crown_set } }
				set_country_flag = zin_east_free_crown_set
				add_ideas = zin_east_free_crowns
				every_other_country = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_free_crown_set }
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_free_crown_kin }
					PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_free_crown_kin } }
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
					PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_east_knelt } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_east_story_month = {
	# the story beats of sections 5 and 6, each once, read from the story flags (runner scope)
	# envoys speak of the rift once the Golden King has been dead a year, or from the shifted date
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_gk_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_gk_seen
		set_global_flag = { flag = zin_east_gk_wait days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				zin_east_after_rift_talk = yes
				AND = {
					has_global_flag = zin_east_gk_seen
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_gk_wait }
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				check_variable = { zin_footholds > 2.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_rift_talk }
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_rift_talk
			country_event = { id = zin_east.40 }
		}
	}
	# the coalition gathers 30 days after the war begins; outside the historical path also when the dark has gathered
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_gather_sent }
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
				AND = {
					zin_rules_is_historical = no
					check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 69.99 }
					zin_east_after_early_coalition = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_gather_sent
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
			country_event = { id = zin_east.41 days = 30 }
		}
		else = { country_event = { id = zin_east.41 } }
	}
	# the host turns west 120 days after the crossing if the coalition holds 3 Magical Lands states, or at the shifted date on the historical path
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_turns_west }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_e_held = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_region_magical_lands = yes
				controller = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_e_held = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_invasion_young }
						check_variable = { zin_e_held > 2.99 }
					}
					AND = {
						zin_rules_is_historical = yes
						zin_east_after_turn_west = yes
					}
				}
			}
			zin_east_turn_west = yes
		}
	}
	# the King of the East: the courts not asked hear of him in 30 days; the refusers' floor and the First of the Free Crowns in 60
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_king_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_king_seen
		country_event = { id = zin_east.5 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = zin_east.6 days = 60 }
	}
	# the coalition breaks: every member that refused the King chooses peace or war
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member
				has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_east_peace_asked }
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_east_peace_asked
			country_event = { id = zin_east.45 }
		}
	}
	# abandoned companies, when the stranger returns
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eindil_returned
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_stranded_asked }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_stranded_asked
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				zin_east_at_war_in_the_west = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.46 }
		}
	}
	# the King calls his host
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_returned
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_host_called }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_east_host_called
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_noris_riders_for_host }
				set_country_flag = zin_east_sent_levies
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_east.52 }
		}
	}
	# after the King
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		zin_east_after_the_king = yes
	}
}

zin_east_monthly = {
	# the caravan month: roads, rivalry, the courts, the story beats, the trees' own monthly work, then the focus layouts (E4)
	zin_east_roads_month = yes
	zin_east_rivalry_month = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war
			NOT = { NRS = { has_war_with = STA } }
		}
		clr_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war
		NRS = { remove_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
		STA = { remove_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
		zin_east_country_month = yes
	}
	NRS = { zin_east_update_dominance = yes }
	STA = { zin_east_update_dominance = yes }
	zin_east_free_crowns_month = yes
	zin_east_story_month = yes
	# the trees' monthly work (declared by the Noris and Stabilo trees)
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { zin_noris_monthly = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { zin_stabilo_monthly = yes }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

zin_east_pick_runner = {
	# the runner of the caravan month: Noris; Stabilo if Noris is gone; else the East Lands country with the most states
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NRS }
		NRS = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_east_runner }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = STA }
		STA = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_east_runner }
	}
	else = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_east_in_region = yes
						OR = {
							check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { num_owned_states = PREV.num_owned_states }
								check_variable = { zin_east_rank > PREV.zin_east_rank }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_east_runner
		}
	}
}

zin_east_schedule_month = {
	# the chain of zin_east.2: the runner is picked anew and the next month is scheduled there, so the chain survives the runner's end
	zin_east_pick_runner = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = zin_east_runner }
		event_target:zin_east_runner = { country_event = { id = zin_east.2 days = 30 } }
	}
}

zin_east_on_declare_war = {
	# ROOT declares on FROM: a war between Noris and Stabilo ends the Concord and opens the Caravan War
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					original_tag = NRS
					FROM = { original_tag = STA }
				}
				AND = {
					original_tag = STA
					FROM = { original_tag = NRS }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord }
			clr_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord
			clr_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord_cap
			NRS = {
				remove_ideas = zin_east_shared_roads
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = STA modifier = zin_east_concord }
			}
			STA = {
				remove_ideas = zin_east_shared_roads
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = NRS modifier = zin_east_concord }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war } }
			set_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war
			NRS = { add_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
			STA = { add_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
				news_event = { id = zin_east.25 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_east_on_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_east_coalition_ambition
			NOT = {
				any_enemy_country = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_east_coalition_ambition
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war
			NOT = { NRS = { has_war_with = STA } }
		}
		clr_global_flag = zin_east_caravan_war
		NRS = { remove_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
		STA = { remove_ideas = zin_east_caravan_war_strain }
	}
}

zin_east_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_east_in_crisis days = 365 }
	}
}

zin_east_sign_concord = {
	# the Concord of the Roads (spec section 2): charters freeze, every road half held, the rivalry capped for 1825 days
	set_global_flag = zin_east_roads_concord
	set_global_flag = { flag = zin_east_roads_concord_cap days = 1825 }
	NRS = {
		add_ideas = zin_east_shared_roads
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = STA modifier = zin_east_concord }
	}
	STA = {
		add_ideas = zin_east_shared_roads
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = NRS modifier = zin_east_concord }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry > 30 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry = 30 }
	}
	NRS = { zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes }
	STA = { zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
		news_event = { id = zin_east.24 }
	}
}

zin_east_make_report = {
	# the numbers of the hub's report (zin_east.31): the weight of every East Lands country, and three counts
	set_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_footholds = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_pledged = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_ready = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
		zin_east_compute_weight = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 2.99 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_footholds = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_coalition_weight > 49.99 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_ready = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_east_pledged }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_rep_pledged = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_startup = {
	# the roads open (zin_east.1, one day after the start, so that every startup of the other systems has run)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_east_started } }
		set_global_flag = zin_east_started
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry = 40 }
		# the frozen East Lands state count of the dominance (the roster holds 337)
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_states_total = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_states_total = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_east_states_total < 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_east_states_total = 337 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_wells_turn = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_road = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_last_winner = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_talks_result = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_invite_result = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { zin_rules_ai_random_east = yes }
			random_list = {
				34 = { set_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 0 } }
				33 = { set_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 1 } }
				33 = { set_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 2 } }
			}
		}
		# the tag order of the spec's tie-breaks
		ALR = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 31 } }
		ANE = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 30 } }
		AZA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 29 } }
		DLB = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 28 } }
		DNL = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 27 } }
		DRA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 26 } }
		ELD = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 25 } }
		ERC = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 24 } }
		HRR = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 23 } }
		KRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 22 } }
		LCC = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 21 } }
		LUV = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 20 } }
		MAG = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 19 } }
		MIE = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 18 } }
		MOA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 17 } }
		MOS = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 16 } }
		MSH = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 15 } }
		NAA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 14 } }
		NLR = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 13 } }
		NRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 12 } }
		OBM = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 11 } }
		ORA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 10 } }
		OST = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 9 } }
		PLO = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 8 } }
		PON = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 7 } }
		RHA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 6 } }
		STA = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 5 } }
		TES = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 4 } }
		WAH = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 3 } }
		WOQ = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 2 } }
		YAV = { set_variable = { zin_east_rank = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_salt = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_salt = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_road_salt = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_salt = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_gold = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_gold = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_road_gold = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_gold = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_rift = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_rift = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_road_rift = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_rift = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_lake = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_lake = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_road_lake = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_lake = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_road_sand = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_sand = 0 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_road_sand = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_east_roadn_sand = 1 }
		}
		NRS = {
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_east_noris
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 70 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 10 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 40 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake = 35 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 25 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_caravan_bonus = 0 }
			zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_east_caravan_wealth }
			zin_east_update_dominance = yes
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = "STA" value = 20 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "NAA" value = 25 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "MOA" value = 25 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "ALR" value = 10 }
		}
		STA = {
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_east_stabilo
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt = 10 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold = 70 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift = 30 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake = 25 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand = 40 }
			set_variable = { zin_east_caravan_bonus = 0 }
			zin_east_refresh_wealth = yes
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_east_caravan_wealth }
			zin_east_update_dominance = yes
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = "NRS" value = 20 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "DRA" value = 25 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "PLO" value = 25 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "OBM" value = 25 }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "ALR" value = 10 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_east_in_region = yes
				zin_east_is_power = no
			}
			set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 0 }
		}
		NAA = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 70 } }
		DLB = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 20 } }
		OST = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 15 } }
		MOA = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 10 } }
		ALR = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 0 } }
		KRS = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = 0 } }
		MIE = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -10 } }
		RHA = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -10 } }
		MOS = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -15 } }
		ERC = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -20 } }
		OBM = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -20 } }
		PLO = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -30 } }
		DRA = { set_variable = { zin_east_lean = -70 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_east_in_region = yes }
			set_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias = 0 }
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_region_south_lands = yes
				NOT = { has_state_flag = zin_east_wells }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_east_dry_land }
		}
		zin_east_schedule_month = yes
	}
}

zin_east_undercut = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 19.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRS }
			STA = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NRS = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_salt > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 19.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRS }
			STA = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NRS = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_gold > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 19.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRS }
			STA = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NRS = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_rift > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake > 19.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRS }
			STA = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NRS = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_lake > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand > 19.99 } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRS }
			STA = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 5 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			NRS = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_inf_sand > 19.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_road = 5 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
					zin_east_add_road_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
	zin_east_add_rivalry = yes
}
